title: Alpha 工廠改顯示真實重現紀錄，移除策略列表前 4 筆的假資料

delivered: Added canonical path builder paths.alphaFactory in src/lib/bff-v1/paths.ts and Alpha Factory replication DTO contracts (AlphaFactoryLaneId, AlphaFactoryCard, AlphaFactoryLane, AlphaFactoryPageInfo, AlphaFactoryMeta, AlphaFactoryData, AlphaFactoryEnvelope) in src/lib/bff-v1/dto.ts.

Implemented typed GET /bff/alpha-factory client in src/lib/bff-v1/alphaFactory.ts with normalizeAlphaFactoryCard, normalizeAlphaFactoryEnvelope, getAlphaFactory, and unified mock fixtures (MOCK_REPLICATED, MOCK_SCAFFOLDED, MOCK_DISCOVERED, MOCK_ALPHA_FACTORY_ENVELOPE) using the real hosted record shapes from ALPHA-FACTORY-REPLICATION-READ-20261104.

Updated src/management/pages/phase2/alphaFactoryData.ts so buildAlphaFactoryBuckets consumes /bff/alpha-factory replication lanes instead of strategies.slice(0, 4), removes alphaFactory.replicated.note, and classifyAlphaFactorySource classifies meta.surfaces.alpha_factory status unavailable or transport errors as degraded.

Updated src/management/pages/phase2/AlphaFactoryBoard.tsx to read GET /bff/alpha-factory via alphaFactory.get, render strategy_id, approver, approved_at, queue_status, attempt_count, last_revalidation_at, and experiment_run_ids.length with a not-reported marker for null values, omit Sharpe and risk badges unless supplied by the BFF, link authority_task_id to /management/experiments/<authority_task_id> and strategy_id to /management/strategies/<strategy_id> with encodeURIComponent, retain the open-strategy-list button, and show the degraded error state without empty columns when meta.surfaces.alpha_factory is unavailable or the read fails.

Updated src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts and src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts to remove alphaFactory.replicated.note and the text claiming the BFF does not expose the candidate list, and added bilingual labels for no_candidate_source, unavailable surface, and replication card fields.

Added unit and component tests in src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/alphaFactory.test.ts, src/management/pages/phase2/alphaFactoryData.test.ts, src/management/pages/phase2/AlphaFactoryBoard.test.tsx, src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/contract-drift.test.ts, src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/strictLiveReadOffline.test.ts, and src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/i18nParity.test.ts.
